purpose: Monitor only world facts whose change can alter a current commercial, distribution, provider, legal, or capital-allocation decision.

canonicalIngestion.rule: Observation, inference, contradiction, and decision remain separate. A monitor never authorizes an external action.

signalClasses.name: active-buyer-pain
signalClasses.question: Has the selected buyer's urgent, measurable problem changed?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Re-score the active canary or fallback when urgency, incidence, or buyer alternative changes materially.

signalClasses.name: buyer-willingness-to-pay
signalClasses.question: Is there new external evidence of a buyer accepting, rejecting, or negotiating a bounded price?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Update price hypothesis only from named evidence; never infer a market price from a creator screenshot.

signalClasses.name: distribution-channel-economics
signalClasses.question: Did a channel produce new trusted cost, founder-minute, payment, acceptance, renewal, or complaint evidence?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Reallocate only when cleared contribution per founder minute can be computed from trusted receipts.

signalClasses.name: provider-price-or-limit-change
signalClasses.question: Did a model, research, enrichment, browser, mailbox, sequencer, payment, or communications provider change price or limits?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Recompute the affected unit-economics range and block activation if the cost ceiling is exceeded.

signalClasses.name: provider-policy-or-availability-change
signalClasses.question: Did a provider change acceptable use, regional availability, authentication, rate limits, or sender requirements?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Fail closed for the affected provider/channel until policy compatibility is re-adjudicated.

signalClasses.name: legal-or-regulatory-change
signalClasses.question: Did a regulator materially change commercial messaging, privacy, tax, invoicing, payment, or AI obligations in an active jurisdiction?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Pause affected activation; obtain external professional adjudication when the exact UberBond treatment is uncertain.

signalClasses.name: competitor-mechanism-change
signalClasses.question: Did a current company expose a new reusable mechanism that alters UberBond's capability gap or offer differentiation?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Update the mechanism library; select build, adapter, compose, reference, defer, or reject after checking current main.

signalClasses.name: software-license-or-maintenance-change
signalClasses.question: Did a reusable repository change license, activity, security posture, or maintenance status?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Re-evaluate reuse and block incorporation when licensing or maintenance is uncertain.

signalClasses.name: partner-ecosystem-opening
signalClasses.question: Did a directory, platform, agency network, marketplace, referral program, or MCP registry create a lower-cost route to multiple downstream accounts?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Score downstream account leverage, partner margin, support burden, lock-in, and proof requirements.

signalClasses.name: owned-distribution-discovery-change
signalClasses.question: Did search, answer-engine, crawler, or structured-data guidance change enough to affect owned distribution?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Update technical access or measurement; never substitute scaled low-value content for evidence-backed assets.

signalClasses.name: commercial-failure-or-loss
signalClasses.question: Did UberBond lose a deal, fail delivery, receive a complaint, refund, dispute, rejection, or non-renewal?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Write a failure mechanism, update kill conditions, and re-score the offer/channel without erasing prior evidence.

signalClasses.name: founder-minute-bottleneck
signalClasses.question: Did a repeated workflow consume enough founder time to change economic allocation?
signalClasses.decisionTrigger: Classify as AUTOMATE, AI_EMPLOYEE, PARTNER, OWNER_ONLY, or DELETE and create only the smallest evidence-backed gap packet.

neverMonitor: generic AI news with no named decision impact
